subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

My wife as well as my friends __are going to Italy__.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "My wife as well as my friends are going to Italy" uses **"are" **where it should use **"is" **due to the subject-verb agreement rule.
 
• When we connect two subjects with **"as well as",** the verb should agree with the first subject. Here the singular verb **"is"** should be used because the first noun **"My wife"** is singular.
 
• Hence, the corrected sentence is "My wife as well as my friends is going to Italy."

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 ("have gone to Italy") **changes the tense of the sentence, which is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3 ("No Substitution") **is incorrect as the original sentence needs to be fixed for the grammatical error in subject-verb agreement.
 
• **Option 4 ("were going to Italy") **indicates past continuous tense, which makes it grammatically incorrect in this context.
